message: So, the family group chat lit up like a Christmas tree when the storm rolled in last night. I had to chuckle as everyone shared their best lightning stories and safety tips. It’s nice to know we’re all looking out for each other, even if it’s a bit chaotic! 🌩️ Just a gentle reminder to stay safe and keep those flashlights handy — you never know when the power might decide to take a little holiday.
